intro.text: A Lurcher kidnapped by the Set and kept in its underground Community.

items.text: Taken by the Vanishers in 341 PC, Fialia woke to be told that the Ashmounts were erupting and that she had been chosen to carry on civilization. After two years moving between caverns and five more in Wayfarer, she fully believed it. In 348 PC she, Armal and Drenya pulled the stranger Marasi indoors to hide her from the mayor, then helped take her to Gave Entrone's mansion. Afterwards Marasi led the captives up to the surface.
